notes.title: Fisherman's House is getting an Overhaul!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]When I first released [b][i]Fisherman’s House[/i][/b], it was my very first game, and to be honest, a lot of it was experimental. Especially the VR side. Looking back, there is a lot I would do different now.[/p][p]I’ve read your feedback, and I really appreciate everyone who took the time to play it and say what they thought.[/p][p]So... I’m working on a complete overhaul.[/p][p]The plan is to release a major update in [b]Q4 2025[/b] that improves almost every part of the game. It’s not just bugfixes – it’s a full rework, built on everything I’ve learned since launch and the time in my study.[/p][p]Here’s what’s coming:[/p][list][*][p]Much better [b]VR controls and comfort options[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Smoother [b]movement and interactions[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]lighting, audio, and atmosphere[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked puzzles and escape logic[/p][/*][*][p]A smarter, dynamic and more fair [b]Fisherman AI[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]If you’ve played it already – thank you. If you refunded it – fair enough, but maybe give it another look later this year. I’m doing my best to turn this into the game it should’ve been.[/p][p]If you’ve got suggestions or ideas – drop a comment below. I read [b]all[/b] of them.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay safe. [/p][p]And don’t make too much noise.[/p]

notes.title: Your wishes for the final launch
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Soon the final version of Fisherman's House will be released with last improvements.

For this reason, I would like to ask everyone if they have any requests for this game that they would like to implement. After the final release, I will invest time in another project that will be different from this game. It will also be a horror game that will be released on Steam. Before I start my new project, I want to finish Fisherman's House for release. 

[b]Be creative![/b]
I will review every comment and the best ideas will be implemented.

It is also possible to write me directly via Discord.
https://discord.gg/pEktphe5WM

Until then
Your developer @platuro

notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In this month, Fisherman's House will receive a new Update, including a complete new feature and new A.I.

[b]What's new?[/b]
It is now possible to flash the fisherman by finding batteries and pressing the R button.
If you get caught by the fisherman, you go to the next night
The fisherman now also searches in hiding places

[b]Removed[/b]
Sprinting has been removed
The old house has been removed

[b]Previous version[/b]
It is still possible to play the previous version by selecting it on Steam by right clicking on the game -> Settings -> Betas -> Previous Version.

This update can soon be downloaded anywhere.

Have fun!

notes.title: AMA + Development Stream
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

In few days ago I will start a stream where you can ask me anything about the future of fisherman's house, and maybe you want to share some ideas. It's also a possibility to talk to the fisherman's house community.

Inside this stream, I will work on a new level for fisherman's house via Unity3D. So if you are interested in how I work with Unity, this could be interesting for you.

The Event will start on February 25th at 19:00 UTC.

Have a nice, fun day,
the developer

notes.title: Gramophone Update + New AI and Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

With today's update, I added a new item called “gramophone”. 
It is possible to use this gramophone to lure the fishermen to a certain place, which makes the gameplay a bit more interesting.

The AI has been greatly revised, but it is still not up to date. If anyone notices a new AI bug, feel free to let me know. I will look for a solution as soon as possible. 

Some other bug fixes are also included in this update, such as preventing clipping, soft locking and item searching bugs.

Also feel free to join our Discord server where you can easily contact me:
https://discord.gg/vCYMQZ2agt

Have a nice day!

notes.title: New Fixes + Language Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

In today's update there are a few new bug fixes and an important new feature:

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fisherman got stucked in the "main office".
[*] Player started to float while running
[*] Chinese was temporarily disabled due to font issues
[*] If the axe was taken on the guillotine, you hide there too
[*] Toilet lids have been repaired
[/list]

[b]New implementation[/b]
[list]
[*]It is now possible to change the main language in the options menu
[/list]

Have a nice Day!

notes.title: Another Day, Another Fix
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Yesterday I fixed some bugs and made some small improvements to the game.

Today's update includes a fix for a few new known bugs and a small cosmetic change that the fisherman's eyes change when he sees you or not.

This will be the last update for the next few days, as I will be taking a few days off over Christmas.

See you soon in the house of the fisherman!

notes.title: AI Optimizations and little Gameplay changes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This update includes some changes:

[b]Fishermen[/b]
[list]
[*] New animations of the fisherman
[*] Fisherman has a green, glowing eye (will be described in more detail in one of the next updates)
[*] Fisherman runs faster now
[*] Fisherman got a revised AI that reacts better when he is not moving (prevents him from getting stuck)
[/list]
[b]Player[/b]
[list]
[*] The player now runs faster, but also has less stamina
[*] Some hiding places have also been adjusted
[/list]
[b]Graphics[/b]
There are minor new adjustments to the blooming effect, saturation and contrast.

[i][b]Have a nice day[/b][/i]

notes.title: VR + Christmas Update!

See you soon at the fisherman's house.

notes.title: November Update!
notes.notes:
Dear beloved guests,

[b]The November Update is now unlocked![/b]
I will explain to you what the November update will include.

[b]What's new[/b]?

[b]Nightmare mode[/b]
The biggest change in the November update is the Nightmare mode. Nightmare Mode includes several changes to the game, such as randomly generated events like jumpscares, sound effects, and more. 

[b]Stamina[/b]
Stamina so the player can't run unlimited, to be fair the fisherman doesn't have unlimited stamina either. 

[b]Hiding places[/b]
Some additional hiding places in the game, such as hiding under a bed.

[b]Improvements[/b]
There are also some improvements to the enemy AI, as sometimes the AI did not interact properly with the player. Another change is that all known clitches, such as going to the toilet to avoid Jumpscare, have been removed.

See you soon at the fisherman's house.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41160803/e5a19598f8bc1aafa52cd028e672e2a862615a2c.png[/img]
